reason: Tier 2: add learned relative-position attention biases to the SASRec expert. The strongest improvement came from combining collaborative and sequential signals, while subsequent loss, fusion, and graph-regularization experiments remained below the 0.5950 best score. SASRec currently lacks an explicit attention parameter for interaction distance; learning this relationship could strengthen its complementary sequential signal without imposing the recency weighting that previously failed.

plan.model_design: Add a zero-initialized relative_attention_bias parameter of shape [num_heads, maxlen] to each SASRec attention block, representing learned biases for causal interaction distances. In log2feats(), compute query-position minus key-position, gather the corresponding per-head biases, mask future positions with negative infinity, and expand to the [batch * num_heads, length, length] additive attention mask accepted by nn.MultiheadAttention. This introduces a learned temporal relationship while initially reproducing existing attention behavior; preserve absolute positional embeddings, padding handling, SASRec.forward(self, seq, pos=None, neg=None), predict(self, seq, candidates), and all existing variable names and return shapes. Keep the graph expert, SASRec sampled-softmax objective, sampling, and fusion unchanged to isolate this architectural addition.
plan.training_evaluation: Preserve train_sasrec(), train_dataset(), optimizer settings, independent seed-42 streams, checkpoint selection, fusion grid, and existing runtime allocations; optimizer construction over model.parameters() will include the new bias tables. Save an explicit architecture-version field with SASRec checkpoints, update load_sasrec() and the predictor writer to reconstruct that version, and preserve predict(user_id, history, candidates, *, dataset_name=None) across all four dataset routes. Add small RNG-isolated checks for zero-bias equivalence, finite nonzero bias gradients, causal masking, candidate-order preservation, and checkpoint-to-generated-predictor score agreement. Retain supplied seed-0 splits, DATA_DIR = os.environ['GAGC_DATA_DIR'], trial-local artifacts, single-GPU execution, SASREC_EPOCHS default 200, and the shared budget; measure macro validation HR@10 against 0.5863 and historical best 0.5950 using the unchanged pinned protocol. Print the measured four-category macro-average as the final Final Validation Score line, leaving hidden-test access and final inference to the host.
